title: FinixDoc: Rethinking Financial Document Parsing Beyond Saturated Benchmarks
abstract: arXiv:2608.22842v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Financial document parsing requires accuracy, structural consistency, and verifiability that current benchmarks often fail to reflect. We present FinixDoc, an end-to-end agentic parsing system for real-world financial documents, with FinixDoc-VL, a 4B-scale vision-language model built on Qwen3-VL-4B, as its core parser. To characterize the gap between benchmark and deployment performance, we introduce a Document Parsing Capability Matrix organized along two practical axes: visual quality and document scale. Guided by this matrix, FinixDoc-VL is trained with a domain-adapted recipe combining homoglyph-aware contrastive learning and multi-stage reinforcement learning with composite domain-specific rewards. To better leverage our accumulated advantage in low-quality financial-document data and support large-scale, high-quality data production, we further build a human-in-the-loop Data Factory pipeline with confidence-aware expert review. translated_title: FinixDoc：重新思考金融文档解析，超越饱和基准
translated_abstract: 金融文档解析需要准确性、结构一致性和可验证性，而当前基准往往无法反映这些要求。我们提出了FinixDoc，一个用于真实世界金融文档的端到端代理解析系统，并以FinixDoc-VL——一个基于Qwen3-VL-4B构建的40亿规模视觉语言模型——作为其核心解析器。为了刻画基准测试与部署性能之间的差距，我们引入了一个文档解析能力矩阵，该矩阵沿两个实用维度组织：视觉质量和文档规模。在此矩阵的指导下，FinixDoc-VL采用了一种领域自适应训练配方，结合了同形字感知对比学习和多阶段强化学习及复合领域特定奖励。为了更好利用我们在低质量金融文档数据方面的积累优势，并支持大规模、高质量的数据生产，我们进一步构建了一个带置信度感知专家审核的人机协同数据工厂流水线。
tldr: 本文提出FinixDoc系统及其核心模型FinixDoc-VL，通过能力矩阵指导的领域自适应训练和人机协同数据工厂，解决了真实金融文档解析中基准与部署性能脱节的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces FinixDoc and its core model FinixDoc-VL, addressing the gap between benchmark and deployment performance in real-world financial document parsing via capability-matrix-guided domain-adaptive training and a human-in-the-loop data factory.
